name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Reliability and playback fixes. Sparse configuration saves no longer erase friends, mappings or sharing/privacy settings; friend limits and consent updates preserve omitted values. Rating ceilings now apply through series and seasons to unrated episodes. Capped playback retains audio and text-subtitle choices, universal audio works through the owner gateway, and read-ahead link failures fall back safely. Includes everything in 0.0.205.
